subtitleFacts.fact1: A tiny tool can turn a tedious task into a two-minute win.
subtitleFacts.fact2: The web was designed to keep information connected—and Kit keeps your work close to home.
subtitleFacts.fact3: Programmers often use 256 because it is 2⁸: a neat bridge between numbers and bytes.
subtitleFacts.fact4: Kit’s tools run in your browser, so your files can stay on your device.
subtitleFacts.fact5: A good workflow leaves more room for the interesting parts.
subtitleFacts.fact6: Kit keeps everyday tools close, simple, and private.
subtitleFacts.fact7: No account, no upload — open a tool and you’re already done logging in.
subtitleFacts.fact8: Timers, converters, and PDFs, all in the same tab as your work.

history.title: History
history.subtitle: Optional local summaries of completed tool actions. Your files are never saved here.
history.empty: No activity yet. Run a tool and it will show up here.
history.recordingOn: On — short summaries may be saved on this device.
history.recordingOff: Off — Kit will not add new activity to History.
history.clearConfirm: Delete all history on this device?

favorites.title: Favorites
favorites.subtitle: Tools you keep close for one-tap access.
favorites.empty: No favorites yet. Star a tool from Home or from its page.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: These choices stay in this browser only.
settings.clearHistoryDesc: Removes local history summaries stored by this site.
settings.privacyNote: Kit works on your files in the browser. Preferences and history summaries may be saved locally. Full details are in the Privacy Policy.

pdf-merge.name: Merge PDFs
pdf-merge.description: Stack several PDFs into one. Preview pages and drag to reorder.
pdf-merge.keywords: pdf merge combine join stitch multipage
pdf-merge.empty: Add at least two PDF files.

pdf-split.name: Split PDF
pdf-split.description: Pull out a page range into a brand-new PDF.

pdf-organize.name: Organize pages
pdf-organize.description: Rotate pages, remove the ones you don’t need, and set a new order.
pdf-organize.keywords: pdf rotate delete reorder organize pages

pdf-compress.name: Shrink as images
pdf-compress.description: Rasterize each page to JPEG. Text, links, and vectors are not kept.
pdf-compress.keywords: pdf compress reduce size smaller rasterize jpeg
pdf-compress.note: Every page is turned into a JPEG picture and rebuilt as a new PDF. Searchable text, links, and vector drawings are removed. Files can get larger. Use this for photo-heavy scans, not contracts you still need to search. Only the first 200 pages are processed.
pdf-compress.success: Shrunk PDF is ready to download.

pdf-watermark.name: Watermark PDF
pdf-watermark.description: Stamp text as a watermark, header, or footer on every page.
pdf-watermark.keywords: pdf watermark stamp header footer confidential

pdf-redact.name: Cover content
pdf-redact.description: Draw black boxes over a page preview. This is a visual cover, not true redaction.
pdf-redact.keywords: pdf redact blackout hide sensitive cover
pdf-redact.note: This is a visual cover only. Underlying text can still be selected, copied, or recovered. Do not use it for secrets that must be destroyed.
pdf-redact.drawHint: Drag on the page to cover a region. Add as many boxes as you need, then apply.

pdf-extract.name: Extract from PDF
pdf-extract.description: Pull readable text or export pages as JPEG images (ZIP).
pdf-extract.imagesReady: Exported {count} page image(s) as a ZIP.
pdf-extract.limits: Text and page images are produced in this tab. Only the first 200 pages are processed. Image export is a visual raster, not embedded image objects.

image-compress.name: Compress images
image-compress.description: Dial quality and max size down so photos stay shareable.
image-compress.keywords: image compress jpg png webp size photo

image-resize.name: Resize images
image-resize.description: Set exact dimensions, with optional aspect-ratio lock.
image-resize.keywords: image resize scale dimensions width height

image-crop.name: Crop image
image-crop.description: Keep only the rectangle you care about.

image-convert.name: Convert image format
image-convert.description: Switch between JPEG, PNG, WEBP, and similar web formats.
image-convert.keywords: image convert format webp avif png jpg jpeg

image-metadata.name: Image metadata
image-metadata.description: Inspect EXIF and similar tags, then export a clean copy without them.
image-metadata.keywords: image exif metadata strip privacy location
image-metadata.note: Pixels are re-encoded in the browser so embedded metadata is dropped.
image-metadata.noExif: No readable EXIF or text metadata in this file.

convert-hub.name: Smart convert
convert-hub.description: Detect mixed file or text types and convert across formats (not a media studio).
convert-hub.keywords: convert hub smart batch json yaml csv zip image data

json-format.name: JSON formatter
json-format.description: Pretty-print, minify, and catch JSON errors early.
json-format.keywords: json format validate minify pretty print
json-format.success: JSON looks valid and is formatted.

yaml-format.name: YAML formatter
yaml-format.description: Check YAML structure and tidy the layout.

toml-format.name: TOML formatter
toml-format.description: Validate TOML and keep the file neat.

markdown-html.name: Markdown ↔ HTML
markdown-html.description: Turn Markdown into HTML, or HTML back into Markdown.

csv-json.name: CSV ↔ JSON
csv-json.description: Move tabular data between CSV and JSON arrays.

text-diff.name: Text compare
text-diff.description: See line-by-line changes between two versions.

base64.name: Base64
base64.description: Encode or decode Base64 for plain text or whole files.

url-encode.name: URL encode
url-encode.description: Percent-encode or decode URL components safely.
url-encode.keywords: url encode decode percent uri query

audio-convert.name: Convert audio
audio-convert.description: Change audio containers such as MP3, WAV, and OGG in the browser.
audio-convert.keywords: audio convert mp3 wav ogg ffmpeg sound
audio-convert.note: Uses single-thread FFmpeg WASM. Large files can be slow; codec support is limited.

audio-trim.name: Trim audio
audio-trim.description: Keep only the stretch between two timestamps in an audio file.
audio-trim.keywords: audio trim cut clip mp3 wav

audio-speed.name: Audio speed & volume
audio-speed.description: Speed up, slow down, or change loudness of audio.

video-convert.name: Convert video
video-convert.description: Change video containers such as MP4 and WEBM in the browser.
video-convert.keywords: video convert mp4 webm ffmpeg movie
video-convert.note: Uses single-thread FFmpeg WASM. Large files can be slow; codec support is limited.

video-trim.name: Trim video
video-trim.description: Keep only the clip between two timestamps.

video-speed.name: Video speed & volume
video-speed.description: Change playback speed and audio level of a video.

video-extract-audio.name: Extract audio from video
video-extract-audio.description: Save the soundtrack from a video as an audio file.

pdf-numbers.name: Page numbers
pdf-numbers.description: Stamp a page label such as 1 / 12 on every page.
pdf-numbers.keywords: pdf page numbers footer header pagination

pdf-to-images.name: PDF → images
pdf-to-images.description: Rasterize every page to JPEG and download them as a ZIP.
pdf-to-images.keywords: pdf to image jpg jpeg zip pages export
pdf-to-images.limits: Pages are drawn with PDF.js in this tab. Only the first 200 pages are processed. Very large documents can be slow and use a lot of memory. This is a visual raster, not an extract of embedded image objects.

images-to-pdf.name: Images → PDF
images-to-pdf.description: Stack photos into a PDF, one image per page. A4 is the default.
images-to-pdf.keywords: images to pdf jpg png combine a4
images-to-pdf.success: {count, plural, one {Built a PDF from # image.} other {Built a PDF from # images.}}
images-to-pdf.limits: Images are converted and assembled locally in this browser. Files are not uploaded. A4 fit is the default; original size keeps each page as large as the photo.

pdf-flatten.name: Flatten forms
pdf-flatten.description: Bake AcroForm fields into the page so they can no longer be edited.
pdf-flatten.limits: Works on standard AcroForm fields. Dynamic XFA forms are not fully supported.

pdf-metadata.name: PDF metadata
pdf-metadata.description: View, edit, or strip title, author, and other document Info fields.
pdf-metadata.title: Title
pdf-metadata.author: Author
pdf-metadata.subject: Subject
pdf-metadata.creator: Creator

pdf-protect.name: Lock or unlock PDF
pdf-protect.description: Add or remove a user password. Encryption stays in this browser.
pdf-protect.keywords: pdf password lock unlock encrypt decrypt
pdf-protect.limits: Uses a client-side PDF encryption library. Some older or unusual encryption revisions may not unlock. Kit never sends the file or password to a server.

image-rotate.name: Rotate & flip
image-rotate.description: Turn images 90° at a time or flip them horizontally or vertically.

image-filters.name: Image filters
image-filters.description: Apply grayscale, sepia, or invert to one or many photos.

image-favicon.name: Favicon pack
image-favicon.description: Export a source image as common icon sizes in a ZIP.
image-favicon.note: Exports PNG files at 16, 32, 48, 180, 192, and 512 pixels.

video-gif.name: Video → GIF
video-gif.description: Turn a short clip into a looping GIF in the browser.
video-gif.limits: Uses FFmpeg WASM. Keep clips short — GIF encode is slow and memory-heavy. Palette and codec support follow the in-browser build.

xml-json.name: XML ↔ JSON
xml-json.description: Convert XML documents to JSON, or JSON back to XML.

sql-format.name: SQL formatter
sql-format.description: Pretty-print SQL so clauses and lists are easier to read.

regex-tester.name: Regex tester
regex-tester.description: Try a regular expression against sample text and replace matches.

hash-generator.name: Hash generator
hash-generator.description: SHA-1/256/384/512 and MD5 of text or a file, computed locally.
hash-generator.keywords: hash sha256 md5 sha1 checksum digest
hash-generator.limits: Hashes are computed in this browser (Web Crypto for SHA, a local MD5 implementation). MD5 is not collision-resistant — use it only for checksums.

uuid-generator.name: UUID generator
uuid-generator.description: Create version 4 or version 7 UUIDs on this device.

color-convert.name: Color converter
color-convert.description: Convert between HEX, RGB, HSL, and HSV, with a color picker.
color-convert.keywords: color hex rgb hsl hsv picker

lorem-ipsum.name: Lorem ipsum
lorem-ipsum.description: Generate placeholder paragraphs, sentences, or words.

qr-code.name: QR code
qr-code.description: Create a QR code from text, or read one from an image.
qr-code.keywords: qr code generate scan read barcode
qr-code.none: No QR code found in that image.

pdf-sign.name: Sign PDF
pdf-sign.description: Stamp a typed signature on every page. Visual only — not a certificate.
pdf-sign.limits: This draws your name on the page. It is not a cryptographic digital signature.

image-watermark.name: Watermark images
image-watermark.description: Overlay text on photos, one file or a whole batch.

password-generator.name: Password generator
password-generator.description: Create a strong password on this device. Nothing is stored.

case-convert.name: Change case
case-convert.description: Switch between camel, snake, kebab, title, and more.
case-convert.keywords: case camel snake kebab pascal title

jwt-decode.name: JWT decoder
jwt-decode.description: Read a JWT header and payload locally. Signatures are not verified.
jwt-decode.limits: Kit only decodes Base64url. It cannot prove the token is authentic without a key.

unix-timestamp.name: Unix timestamp
unix-timestamp.description: Convert Unix time to ISO and back.

cron-explain.name: Cron explainer
cron-explain.description: Turn a 5-field cron expression into plain language.

html-entities.name: HTML entities
html-entities.description: Encode or decode < & and numeric entities.

json-types.name: JSON → TypeScript
json-types.description: Infer TypeScript interfaces from a JSON sample.

everyday-converter.name: Everyday converter
everyday-converter.description: Convert units and currencies with a browser-local cache.
everyday-converter.keywords: unit converter currency converter length mass temperature speed volume data
everyday-converter.limits: Currency rates come from Frankfurter when this tool opens or you tap Refresh, then stay in this browser cache for six hours. Amounts are not sent. Rates are daily reference data, not for trading or tax.
everyday-converter.stale: Cached rate is older than six hours; refresh may be needed.
everyday-converter.typographyHint: Set the root, parent, or screen reference used by rem, em, and pt.
everyday-converter.categoryCurrencyDescription: Live exchange rates with a local cache

text-counter.name: Text counter
text-counter.description: Count words, characters, sentences, paragraphs, and reading time.
text-counter.keywords: word counter character counter text statistics reading time
text-counter.limits: Counts use browser-native Unicode segmentation when available. Reading time is about 220 words/min for alphabetic text and 400 characters/min for Chinese, Japanese, and Korean.
text-counter.placeholder: Paste or type text here to see a live reading profile.

timezone-converter.name: World clock
timezone-converter.description: See live times around the world, with advanced time zone conversion when you need it.
timezone-converter.keywords: timezone converter time zone world clock DST date time
timezone-converter.limits: Live times use the browser clock and IANA time-zone rules, including daylight-saving changes. Advanced conversion lets you compare a specific local date and time across zones.
timezone-converter.convertHint: Choose a source zone and a destination zone.
timezone-converter.invalid: Enter a valid local date and time.
timezone-converter.worldClockHint: A quick glance across common workday zones.
timezone-converter.advancedConversionHint: Compare a specific local date and time across two time zones.

date-calculator.name: Date calculator
date-calculator.description: Compare dates, add time, and count business days with optional holidays.
date-calculator.keywords: date calculator date difference add days business days holidays
date-calculator.limits: Calendar operations use local browser dates. Month and year additions clamp to the last valid day of the target month.

tip-split-calculator.name: Tip & split calculator
tip-split-calculator.description: Calculate tip, tax, totals, and fair shares for a group.
tip-split-calculator.keywords: tip calculator split bill tax gratuity restaurant shares
tip-split-calculator.limits: Tip and tax are calculated from the subtotal. Rounded shares distribute any remainder to the first people so the split adds back to the total.

bmi-calorie-calculator.name: BMI & calorie calculator
bmi-calorie-calculator.description: Check BMI, a healthy weight range, and daily calorie needs from height, weight, age, and activity.
bmi-calorie-calculator.keywords: bmi calculator calorie tdee bmr mifflin weight healthy
bmi-calorie-calculator.limits: BMI uses adult WHO cutoffs. Under 18 is allowed but marked, because child BMI is usually read against growth charts. Calories use the Mifflin-St Jeor equation, which is an adult formula. Results stay on this device and are not medical advice.
bmi-calorie-calculator.invalid: Enter a realistic height, weight, and age.
bmi-calorie-calculator.minorNote: Adult BMI cutoffs and the Mifflin-St Jeor calorie formula. Child BMI is usually read against growth charts.
bmi-calorie-calculator.veryActiveHint: Hard exercise or a physical job
bmi-calorie-calculator.floorNote: The loss target is floored at {value} kcal so the number stays in a commonly used adult range.
bmi-calorie-calculator.disclaimer: Not medical advice. Adult BMI cutoffs and an adult calorie formula.

stopwatch-timer.name: Stopwatch & timer
stopwatch-timer.description: Run a precise browser stopwatch or countdown timer.
stopwatch-timer.keywords: stopwatch timer countdown clock online timer

random-generator.name: Random generator
random-generator.description: Generate numbers, booleans, choices, or passwords for everyday use.
random-generator.keywords: random number generator choice picker password generator
random-generator.limits: Randomness uses the browser's Math.random source. Results are for everyday choices, not cryptographic secrets.

currency-converter.name: Currency converter
currency-converter.description: Live exchange rates with a local cache
currency-converter.keywords: currency converter exchange rates money Frankfurter
currency-converter.limits: Currency rates come from Frankfurter when this tool opens or you tap Refresh, then stay in this browser cache for six hours. Amounts are not sent. Rates are daily reference data, not for trading or tax.
currency-converter.stale: Cached rate is older than six hours; refresh may be needed.

percentage-calculator.name: Percentage calculator
percentage-calculator.description: Find a percent of a number, reverse a percent, measure change, or apply a percent increase or decrease.
percentage-calculator.keywords: percentage percent calculator increase decrease markup discount
percentage-calculator.invalid: Enter finite numbers. Whole and from values cannot be zero for reverse or change modes.

loan-calculator.name: Loan & interest calculator
loan-calculator.description: Estimate a monthly loan payment or compound interest growth from principal, rate, and years.
loan-calculator.keywords: loan mortgage payment amortization compound interest APR
loan-calculator.limits: Loan mode uses a standard fixed-rate amortization payment. Compound mode compounds periodically (monthly by default). This is an estimate, not financial advice.
loan-calculator.invalid: Enter a non-negative principal and rate, and a positive term.

text-lines.name: Line tools
text-lines.description: Find and replace, sort, or deduplicate lines of text in your browser.
text-lines.keywords: find replace sort lines unique dedupe text list

slugify.name: Slugify
slugify.description: Turn a title into a URL slug, or clean a filename for safe download names.
slugify.keywords: slugify slug url filename sanitize kebab

color-contrast.name: Color contrast
color-contrast.description: Check WCAG contrast between foreground and background colors.
color-contrast.keywords: wcag contrast accessibility aa aaa color readability
color-contrast.limits: Ratio uses WCAG 2 relative luminance for sRGB hex colors. Levels shown are for normal text (AA ≥ 4.5, AAA ≥ 7).

image-palette.name: Image palette
image-palette.description: Pull the dominant colors from a photo for design references.
image-palette.keywords: palette colors extract dominant swatches image
image-palette.limits: Colors are quantized in this tab from a downscaled preview. Results are approximate and stay on this device.

aspect-ratio.name: Aspect ratio
aspect-ratio.description: Reduce width and height to a ratio, or solve for a missing side.
aspect-ratio.keywords: aspect ratio 16:9 dimensions missing side crop
aspect-ratio.invalid: Enter positive sizes and a ratio like 16:9.

meeting-planner.name: Meeting planner
meeting-planner.description: Find overlapping work-hour windows across time zones on a given date.
meeting-planner.keywords: meeting planner timezone overlap world clock work hours
meeting-planner.limits: Overlap uses IANA zones and local calendar dates. Hours are whole UTC hours where every zone is still on the chosen date and inside the work window.
meeting-planner.none: No overlapping work hours for these settings.
meeting-planner.invalid: Check the date, zones, and hour bounds.

json-query.name: JSON query
json-query.description: Flatten nested JSON or read simple JSONPath values like $.items[0].name.
json-query.keywords: json path query flatten jq jsonpath
json-query.limits: Supports a small JSONPath subset: $.a.b, $.items[0], and $['key']. Wildcards and filters are not included.

check-digits.name: Check digits
check-digits.description: Validate ISBN-10/13, EAN-13, and IBAN check digits locally.
check-digits.keywords: isbn ean iban check digit barcode validate
check-digits.limits: Checks the published check-digit algorithms only. A valid check digit does not prove the number is assigned or that an account exists.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: That address isn’t in Kit. Head home and pick a tool from there.

errorPage.title: Something went wrong
errorPage.body: The last action failed in this browser. You can try again without leaving the page.
